अणक a. (f. का) Small, insignificant, low; (as the first part of a Karmadhāraya, it implies deterioration or contempt, अणककुलालः S.K.)
आणक (II) n. Sexual enjoyment in a certain position. (आणक सुरत नाम दम्पत्योः पार्श्वसंस्थयोः).
